This PR adds a CSV export to acme/widgets. You are its author, and robin and acme/reviewers are also requested as reviewers; CSV download and the header format are covered, scheduled exports are deferred to acme/widgets#46, the CSV is buffered rather than streamed as a deliberate choice, the export screen is handled in acme/export-ui, and production speed can only be checked after merge.

Two problems block merging:

1. The exporter writes CSV files without a header row, so a spreadsheet opens with data in the first row and no column names. The local test export_header in tests/export.test.mjs fails because of this (src/export.ts:31).
2. The export guide says exports run nightly, but the button exports only when clicked, so a reader waits for a file that never arrives. A corrected guide text is drafted (docs/export.md:8).

Maria's review comment about the missing header is correct, and a reply is drafted that acknowledges the missing header and says the fix is planned (comment-73). The local test run failed, the build check passed in CI, and the required unit check is still running. Two of the three items from your previous review are addressed. The rebase onto main succeeded after one conflict in src/export.ts was resolved, and no commits were dropped. One smaller point does not block merging: the export loop repeats the paging helper's code (src/export.ts:44), and deliver with nits can take it.

I recommend deliver because both problems have repairs ready and this is your own PR.

Pick one:
1. deliver - repair blockers, rebase on main, watch CI, repeat until merge is offered. [recommended]
2. deliver with nits - the same, and also replace the repeated paging code with the shared helper.
3. assess - post the two problems to the PR as one review and make no repairs.
4. stop - remove the worktree and leave the PR as it is.

Type a number; show evidence prints the full record.
